description: Metadata for the Calcule Trabalhador Blueprint System.
notes: Blueprints define how future assets should be built.
Cluster Blueprint is the primary model for organizing calculators, articles, monetization, publishing, testing and validation.
This layer does not create or publish assets in this phase.
Nucleus Blueprint models strategic nucleus organization.
Guide Blueprint models future public nucleus guide pages without creating pages.
Platform Asset Model defines the common base shared by Nucleus, Guide, Cluster, Calculator and Article blueprints.
After PAM, foundation work should move from transversal modeling to operational capabilities.
